text:
kevin: Heads-up — Deploybot scheduled for 22:00 UTC tonight. Plan to toggle feature flag svc-route-v2 in an incremental burst. I'll pin version 2.3.1 to the dedicated pool for 60m after full ramp.

maria: 👍 what's the explicit rollback/hold thresholds?

kevin: Primary rollback: error-rate > 0.8% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 800ms. Secondary: token-cost spike > 15% vs baseline or user-facing anomalies.

sam: can deploy-bot auto-pin the previous stable on rollback?

deploy-bot: Deploybot: scheduled deploy by kevin at 2026-03-23T22:00:00Z. Automated rollback actions: enabled. Auto-pin-on-rollback: true. Notifications routed to #eng-oncall.

jess: Confirming traffic slices: cohort-a = web-canary, cohort-b = web-canary-2, internal = internal-test.

kevin: Ramp plan (30m total):
```
0-10m: 10% -> svc-route-v2 (cohort-a only)
10-20m: 50% -> cohort-a + cohort-b
20-30m: 100% -> all traffic
Pin: version 2.3.1 to dedicated pool for 60m post-100%
```

maria: Add soft-backoff rule: if median latency doubles in any cohort or any shard sees >0.5% 5xx in a 3m window, drop back to 10% and hold for 10m.

kevin: Agreed. Enabling soft-backoff and fast-drain guard. Also muting non-critical alerts, keeping paging to ops-oncall.

ops-oncall: I'll monitor dashboards (errors, p95, token cost, user error traces). Please @ops-oncall if auto-rollback triggers so we can triage quickly.

alex: Draft release notes (will PR):
- Enable svc-route-v2 with staged traffic ramp
- Pin version 2.3.1 for quick rollback/fallback
- Added heat-check counters and per-cohort latency telemetry
Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/6821

sam: Quick sanity command to spoof cohort header: `curl -H 'X-Test-Cohort: cohort-a' https://api.internal/redwood/route`

kevin: Post-deploy smoke checklist:
- Verify 5xx < 0.2% across cohorts
- Confirm cohort latency delta < 200ms vs baseline
- Confirm token cost unit delta within 10%
- If everything OK, unpin after 60m and monitor additional 30m

jess: I'll update the runbook and open the release-note PR. Adding the soft-backoff conditions to the runbook now.

kevin: Quick operational knobs I'll set:
- deploybot ramp schedule (as above)
- soft-backoff = ON
- fast-unpin disabled until 60m hold complete
- alert routing -> #eng-oncall (critical), #eng-releases (info)

maria: If the auto-rollback happens, do we want a manual decision window before unpinning? Suggest: keep pinned for 30m after rollback so we can iterate.

kevin: Yes, hold pin 30m post-rollback, then evaluate and unpin with a follow-up canary if needed.

ops-oncall: I'll stand by during the window. Have dashboards and traces ready.

kevin: Rolling according to schedule. Tag me on any anomalies. :rocket:
